inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev3 PROGRESSIVE UFO runtime assembly, dev2 rigid joint partitioning/multi-GMX assembly, and inherited 2.9/2.10 native-format, mod-workspace and source-only gates remain inherited. Dev4 adds backward-compatible static native pose sampling, the CRAB first-visible runtime assembly preset, and beginner GUI modes/help.

lineage_resolution.note: Resolved in live dev4 lineage API from A7 bos_013.gmx registry + explicit Crab.cpp part-construction/runtime linkage; old dev19 unresolved table remains historical.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 86/86 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this candidate evidence.

limitations: CRAB preset represents the executable-defined first-visible frame-167 static snapshot; later attack/damage formations are not collapsed into this catalog entry.
PROGRESSIVE UFO preset remains the first recovered five-part runtime formation; later dynamic phase/movement formations are not collapsed into its static catalog entry.
True blended/multi-joint deformation is not encoded; triangles spanning rigid joint partitions are rejected because no confirmed native per-vertex skin representation exists.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX for multipart runtime entities.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free TEX wrapper synthesis remains structurally validated rather than hardware/emulator-proven.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX no-op evidence and dev7 retail skin-field evidence are inherited rather than rerun/bundled from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
